indicator_name: Alternative core inflation measures: trimmed means, weighted median, diffusion indices (computed by this repository from 21 CPI components)
description: Альтернативные меры базовой инфляции: усечённое среднее, взвешенная медиана, индексы диффузии (расчёт репозитория по 21 компоненте ИПЦ)
methodology: NOT an official BNS measure. Components (CPI_DETAIL_MOM, national): 9 food groups, non-alcoholic drinks, alcohol, tobacco, divisions 03-12, with the 2022 official BNS weights (CPI_WEIGHTS at 2022-12-31, renormalised over the components present, food n.e.c. excluded) held fixed -- BNS reweights every January, item weights are not published. Trimmed means cut 15 % / 30 % of the weight from each tail of the sorted m/m changes; the weighted median is the change at half the weight. COMPONENTS_MEAN is the plain weighted mean (compare with CPI_MOM to judge the approximation). Diffusion: weight share of components with m/m above 0 and above 0.4074 % (5 % a year). A food or drink group a release does not print (the 2026 COICOP-2018 basket lacks bread, eggs, sugar groups; September 2026 prints only divisions) takes its division's change (CP01 or CP02), counted in N_FILLED_BY_DIVISION; CP12 in 2026 is CP13_2018 (personal care and other goods and services). 12-month figures compound twelve monthly changes. Not seasonally adjusted.
